item.tib: khrid rim mun pa gsal byed
item.coloph: gdams pa gnad dang bcas pa 'di rnams/ rig 'dzin mkhyen pa can rnams kyis/ phyi rabs kyi don du snyan rgyud yi ger bris te/ mi rul rtsi dang sman gyis byug pa byas te/ mnga' gsol bkra shis dar ba'i smon lam dang bcas te/ bka' srung rnams la bcol gnyer gtad cing sbas so/ phyi rabs bus kyang man ngag 'di rnyed nas lo nyi shu rtsa gsum nas las can gyi gshen po nyi ma shar nas sum cu so lnga yong bas/ 'di byin na bstan pa dar zhing rgyas so/ dad mos can brgya rtsa yong / kha dad can mang du 'byung bas btang bzhag tshod zin par bya'o/ spel dus su tshogs btang / gsol ba gdab/ spel snga na bar chod mong (mang/)phyis na lo tshig 'das te bstan pa mi dar bas/ brtag shes pa kha gsal la khong dam pa cig gis rnyed pa'i smon lam btab ste sbas pas/ phyi rabs gshen pos kyang las can la tshang bar gtad/ zog po kha sag can bon gyi tshong pa la gsang bar bya/ u ya/ (?) 'di rnyed bus kyang dad ldan la khrid kyi ngo sprod/ la la bsgrub pa sbyin/ las can skal bar ldan bar la man ngag ma bu tshang bar gtad btang bzhag la tshod zin par ma byas na/ mkha' 'gros bka' skyon par yong ngo/ rgya rgya rgya/ s+ya mya spya/ rgya gsum btab so (bo//)
